ns2:course.label: Thesis Seminar
ns2:course.description: (EOL 491) Assists doctoral candidates in planning field studies and thesis problems; students are expected to present their studies at each of four stages: (1) the inception, delimitation, tentative design stage; (2) the proposed design stage; (3) the revised design stage; and (4) the final design stage. Students are expected to analyze all presentations critically. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
